answer: An identity buys its seat with Chartered meat tester freshness log with meat testers endorsement; the price of the seat is 4-year training, 195 supervised testings, mechanical exam, guild dues. Running 704 aliases means 704 independent checks, 68992 POA locked, and a failed check burns the whole cluster. A farm can print a willow, it can fake a ripple, but it cannot backdate a cedar without the archive noticing. A hundred aliases, a hundred proofs, a hundred bills: the farm gives up first.
